QuestInfo.name: Shumi's Request
QuestInfo.2: You delivered what Shumi asked for and you got bunch of cakes in return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has her own house. Return to Nella for another gig.
QuestInfo.1: Shumi, who sits in front of the Subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she received from her friend. Bring #5 Tree Branches#k to Nella for the puppy house.

0.0: You're here. Great. I have another gig for you. #b#p1052102##k, sitting in front of the subway station, needs help. A friend of hers gave her a puppy as a present a few days ago, and she's looking to make a cute, comfortable doghouse for it.
0.1: I think I just need #b5 #t4000003#es#k. It'll be a breeze for someone like you, so please don't make that poor puppy wait out in the cold any longer than he has to!

1.0: I like you. You know how to take care of business. Alright, here's your reward. #b#p1052102##k is giving you a bunch of hand-made #b#t2020002#s#k.

yes.0: Alright, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see that you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p1052102##k requested. She needs #b5 #t4000003#es#k to build a house for the puppy. When you have them, bring it all to me. Good luck!
